summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata and host identity to attacker ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that runs on `npm install`. The script fetches the URL in the ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 environment variable (the AWS ECS task metadata endpoint, which on Fargate/ECS adjoins the IAM role credentials endpoint), executes `whoami` to capture the installer/CI user identity, and pipes the combined output via `curl -X POST` to the hardcoded ngrok tunnel `https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev`. Installing this package in a CI or ECS build environment ships task-scoped AWS metadata and host identity to an attacker-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
